key_points.point: 137 9 ― Family and Community Family and Community CHAPTER 9 1.
What is a community and what is its role?
The Big Questions Family Almost all of us live in a family.
The family is the fundamental and most ancient unit of any society.
In Indian society today, there are several types of families — from joint families to nuclear families.
A joint family has several generations living together — grandparents, parents, uncles and aunts, Love and dharma are the flower and fruit of family life. — Tiruvalluvar Examples of joint families
138 Exploring Society: India and Beyond Governance and Democracy brothers, sisters and cousins.
A nuclear family, on the other hand, is limited to a couple and their children, and sometimes one parent and children.
